videos.caption: Coca-Cola Cake 🥤🍫 This old-fashioned Coca-Cola Cake is rich, incredibly moist, and covered with a warm chocolate frosting that melts right into the cake. Mini marshmallows bake into the batter, giving this nostalgic 9×13 cake an extra-soft texture. You can get the more detailed version with extra tips, step-by-step help, and a printable recipe on my website. Visit my blog through the link in my bio! For the cake: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 cups granulated sugar ½ teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup Coca-Cola 1 cup salted butter ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder ½ cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mini marshmallows For the frosting: ½ cup salted butter 3 Tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 6 Tablespoons Coca-Cola 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3¾ cups powdered sugar 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, optional Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish. Whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the Coca-Cola, butter, and cocoa powder. Heat until the butter melts and the mixture just begins to simmer, whisking occasionally. Pour the hot cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until combined. Add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla, stirring just until smooth. Fold in the mini marshmallows. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. About five minutes before the cake finishes baking, melt the butter with the cocoa powder and Coca-Cola in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove it from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth. Stir in the nuts, if using. Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread it evenly. Let the frosting set before slicing. #cocacolacake #chocolatecake #southerndessert #oldfashionedrecipes #cakerecipe Coca-Cola cake recipe, old-fashioned Coca-Cola cake, Southern chocolate cake, chocolate sheet cake, 9×13 cake recipe, chocolate cake with warm frosting, nostalgic dessert recipe

Preheat oven to 325°F. Line three 8-inch round pans with parchment. 2. Whisk dry ingredients together. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk wet ingredients together. 4. Add dry ingredients to wet. Whisk until smooth. 5. Let batter sit for 5 minutes, then whisk again for 10 seconds. 6. Divide evenly between pans. 7. Bake at 325°F for 25 minutes, until centers are set. 8. Cool 10-15 minutes in pans, then remove/cool completely. Filling Ingredients 120 g butter of choice (3 sticks) 60 g heavy cream of choice (~1/4 cup) 120 g powdered sugar (1 cup) 20 g light corn syrup (1 tbsp) 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ⅛ tsp fine sea salt Instructions 1. Heat butter and heavy cream together until fully melted and smooth. 2. Whisk in powdered sugar until completely smooth and glossy. 3. Add syrup, vanilla, and salt.  4. Let sit until cool & slightly thickened. Buttercream Ingredients 340 g (3 sticks) butter of choice 520 g (4 cups) powdered sugar 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ¼ tsp fine sea salt 40 g (3 tbsp) heavy cream of choice Instructions 1. Beat butter for 3-5 minutes until light and fluffy. 2. Add powdered sugar and mix for 5-7 minutes. 3. Add vanilla bean paste and salt. 4. Slowly stream in heavy cream and mix on low Assembly 1. Level cake layers if needed. 2. Pipe a buttercream dam around the edge of each layer. 3. Fill the center with lava filling. 4. Stack and repeat with remaining layers.

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

🌋🤎 Mini Dark Chocolate Lava Cakes 🤎🌋 Ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) salted butter 6 oz dark chocolate  2 eggs 2 egg yolks 1/4 cup unpacked brown sugar (40g) 2 tbsp flour Pinch of salt For serving: Powdered sugar Vanilla ice cream Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. 2. Grease 6 cups in a standard muffin tin with butter. 3. Melt: Melt butter & chocolate together in a saucepan over low heat, or in the microwave on high. Stir every 30 seconds until smooth.  4. Mix batter: In a medium bowl, beat eggs, egg yolks, brown sugar, & salt until slightly thickened. Whisk in the chocolate mixture. Fold in the flour until just combined. 5. Fill the tin: Divide batter among 6 of the muffin tin cups (about 3/4 full). 6. Bake: Bake for 7–9 minutes. Pull them out as soon as the tops set. 7. Cool & serve: Let sit for 2–3 minutes before serving. Gently remove the cakes from the muffin tin. Serve with a dusting of powdered sugar & vanilla ice cream. ✡️ SHANA TOVA U’METUKA ✡️ POMEGRANATE & DARK CHOCOLATE LAVA CAKE  IF YOU’RE LOOKING TO MAKE ROSH HASHANAH COOKING FUN & INTERACTIVE I’M HOSTING A LIVE COOKING CHALLENGE  COMMENT ‘LIVE’ FOR MORE DETAILS  - 4 tbsp pomegranate molasses - 3 tbsp pomegranate juice - 1 tbsp caster sugar (for the gel) - 1 tsp cornstarch - 2 tsp water, cold - 200g dark chocolate (60-70%), chopped - 170g unsalted butter - 3 large eggs - 3 large egg yolks - 100g caster sugar (for the batter) - 60g plain flour - 0.3 tsp fine salt - 4 tbsp fresh pomegranate seeds, to garnish - 0.5 tsp flaky sea salt, to garnish - 20g butter or neutral oil, for greasing ramekins - 2 tbsp cocoa powder, for inside of ramekins 1. Pre-heat oven to 390°F (200°C) or if using conventional oven - 425°F (220°C)  2. In a small saucepan, whisk together pomegranate molasses, pomegranate juice and caster sugar. In a separate small jug, dissolve cornstarch with water 3. Heat pomegranate mixture over medium heat. Once gently simmering, whisk in the cornstarch/water mixture and keep stirring for 2 mins until thickened and jammy. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 mins 4. Once cooled, place drop of the pomegranate mixture on a sheet of clingfilm wrap and tightly wrap them. Place in the freezer for minimum of 2 mins to thicken  5. Melt chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl over a pan of simmering water. Set aside once melted 6. In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, egg yolks and sugar until thick, pale and doubled in volume  7. Fold in the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture until combined. Then sift in flour and salt and fold in until no flour streaks. DON’T OVERMIX!!! 8. Grease up ramekins with either softened butter or oil, using kitchen roll to spread evenly. Dust the inside with cocoa powder generously (to prevent sticking)  9. Fill ramekin half way with chocolate mixture, then place pomegranate blob in centre, not touching the edges. Then fill the rest with chocolate mixture and level out 10. Bake for 16 mins and then let cool for 5 mins. Carefully, run a knife around the cake and then flip onto a plate 11. Top with icing sugar and pomegranate seeds 12. ENJOY

Giant Brown Butter Espresso Chocolate Lava Cake Makes 1 x 6” lava cake (perfect for two spoons) Ingredients:      •    100g unsalted butter     •    120g 54% dark chocolate, chopped     •    20g strong espresso or very strong coffee, hot     •    5g freshly ground coffee     •    2 medium eggs     •    2 egg yolks     •    120g caster sugar     •    100g self-raising flour     •    1 tsp vanilla extract     •    Pinch of flaky sea salt     •    Cocoa powder, for dusting the tin Method: 1.     Preheat the oven to 160°C (fan). This batter comes together quickly, so you want the oven ready. 2.    Place the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until it melts, foams, and the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty. Remove from the heat immediately. 3.    Add the chopped dark chocolate, hot coffee, ground coffee, vanilla, and flaky salt to the hot browned butter. Stir until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth. Set aside to cool slightly. 4.    In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, egg yolks, and caster sugar until pale and slightly thickened. This helps create structure while keeping the centre molten. 5.    Stir the flour into the chocolate mixture until just combined. Gently fold the egg mixture into the chocolate in two additions, keeping as much air as possible. 6.    Grease a 6” round tin and dust generously with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess. 7.    Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 18 minutes. The edges should be set, with a soft, slightly wobbly centre. 8.    Rest for 2–3 minutes before serving. Spoon straight from the tin or carefully turn out.

¡Dale un Efecto Wow a tu Pastel! 🎂✨ Las velas volcán no son simples velas; son una experiencia visual que transforma el momento de “Cantar el Cumpleaños” en un verdadero espectáculo. Diseñadas para emitir una columna de chispas brillantes y constantes, estas velas crean un ambiente festivo, elegante y lleno de energía. ¿Por qué elegirlas para tu próximo cumple? Efecto Cinematográfico: Proyectan una luz vibrante que luce increíble en fotos y videos (¡perfectas para Reels y TikTok!). Larga Duración: Tienen una combustión constante que dura entre 30 y 60 segundos, dándote tiempo de sobra para cantar y pedir tus deseos. Seguridad Primero: Están diseñadas para uso en interiores, produciendo un humo mínimo y chispas frías que no dañan el pastel ni queman al contacto accidental. Versatilidad: Su diseño con base puntiaguda permite fijarlas fácilmente en cualquier superficie blanda, desde pasteles y donas hasta botellas de champaña. Instrucciones de Uso Seguro: Colocación: Inserta la base de plástico firmemente en el pastel de forma vertical. Encendido: Enciende el papel de seda superior con un encendedor o fósforo (no es necesario quitar el papel). Distancia: Mantén una distancia de unos 50 cm mientras la vela esté activa. Finalización: Espera unos segundos después de que se apague antes de retirarla, ya que el cartucho puede estar caliente. Tip Pro: Si quieres una foto épica, utiliza dos velas volcán en lugar de una para crear un arco de luz simétrico detrás del pastel. ¡El cumpleañero se sentirá como una verdadera estrella! 🌟 #Cumpleaños #veñas #oferta #puertolacruz #lechería
